About me

From the classroom to the ledger.

I spent several years as a remote ESL tutor, first full-time and later freelance, planning lessons around each learner's level, running group sessions and adjusting materials from feedback. That work taught me to explain clearly, stay organized and keep people moving toward a goal.

After a career break to focus on my health and professional growth, I moved into virtual bookkeeping. I completed the 21-Day Virtual Bookkeeper Challenge and a 30-day remote Xero internship, and earned Xero Associate, Professional and Specialist certifications.

My accountancy studies at the University of San Jose-Recoletos (Dean's Lister, 2020-2022) gave me the foundation in costing, budgeting and financial planning that I now apply to real bookkeeping workflows.

What I bring

Attention to detail, dependable follow-through and clear written and spoken communication with clients and teammates.

What I'm looking for

An entry-level Virtual Bookkeeper role where I can keep client records accurate and keep growing in the industry.

How I work

Remote-ready, organized and comfortable with Xero, QuickBooks Online, Hubdoc and the usual collaboration tools.
